lines.text: AI writes code fast. So why does most AI code still break?
Because speed isn't the problem. Inspection is.
A car factory doesn't trust its welders. It inspects every door.
A software factory is the same line for code: requirements, design, tests, code, review, release.
Between every station, plain code checks the work.
The factory isn't the workers. It's the line, and the inspections.
